name: teleport-card-transfer
intent: Card compresses into a 44px aperture at source (compressMs 200), mid empty hold, then reconstructs from matching aperture at destination (reconstructMs 220).
acceptance: Source aperture opens to apertureOpenPx 44 during compressMs 200; card gone mid-hold
Destination reconstructs only after reconstructMs 220 following empty hold
Both apertures close to 0px when transfer completes
Reduced motion (prefers or data-force) shows reconstructed destination immediately
